# buildingSMART sample files

These IFC files come from buildingSMART International's [Certification-datasets](https://github.com/buildingSMART/Certification-datasets) repository, renamed by schema:

| File prefix | Source folder |
|---|---|
| `ifc2x3-` | `IFC 2.3.0.1 (IFC 2x3 TC1)/Simple-Scene` |
| `ifc4-` | `IFC 4.0.2.1 (IFC 4 ADD2 TC1)/Simple-Scene` |
| `ifc4x3-` | `IFC 4.3.2.0 (IFC 4.3 ADD2)/Simple-Scene` |
| `ifc4-reference-` | `IFC 4.0.2.1 (IFC 4 ADD2 TC1)/ISO Spec - ReferenceView_V1.2` |
